title: Michael Mignola
description: Mike Mignola's Sandperson (or Tusken Raider) reflects the artist's feelings about STAR WARS: "Robot junk, dirty spaceships and cool-looking aliens - everything a 16-year-old kid could have wanted!" Mignola began comics work in the early '80s, pencilling such titles as ROCKET RACOON, THE HULK and ALPHA FLIGHT. In the ten years since, he's rendered COSMIC ODYSSEY and GOTHAM BY GASLIGHT for DC, Marvel's WOLVERINE and BRAM STOKER'S DRACULA for Topps, among many others.
